title: Weekly Commit Velocity by Repo
dataSources: GitHub repositories (`github:repo`), commits (`github:commit`), issues (`github:issue`), and releases (`github:release`).
app: GitHub repository metadata, commit activity feeds, issue trackers, and release publish logs forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=github:commit repo_name=* lines_changed=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats count as commits, sum(lines_changed) as lines_changed by _time repo_name
| sort - _time - commits
description: Tracks weekly commit counts and lines changed across personal GitHub repositories.
value: Velocity by repo shows which side projects get real attention versus repo-create-and-forget experiments.
implementation: Forward commit events with `lines_changed` and chart weekly totals during monthly project reviews.
visualization: Stacked column chart of commits by repo and week.
grandmaExplanation: It spots which personal GitHub repos you actually worked on each week.
